content: This paper introduces a computationally efficient methodology for jointly performing feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical responses, addressing a novel optimization problem that integrates logistic loss and functional features. Using functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, the approach is validated through simulations and real data, showcasing its ability to handle high-dimensional data and identify key features related to chronic diseases and socio-demographic factors.
